'''Maya Armus''' was a high-end spa that doubled as a [[Hutt Temple]], located on [[Napdu]], [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Da Soocha]], and owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].

==History==
Using [[YZ 3000 tanker]]s, water was hauled from the sacred world of Da Soocha for use in the spa. The spa catered to a variety of clientele, including [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], and as such maintained a red-armored security force. It was later destroyed by the [[War Hammer|''War Hammer's'']] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] upon the orders of [[Darth Azard]], in response to Azzim harboring [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees from [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] after it had been [[Final Protocol|cleansed]] of all life, killing everyone who did not take off immediately. This act outraged the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]].
